personal.name: Adamya Varshney
personal.title: Product Manager | AI & Agentic Products
personal.bio:
Hey 👋
I'm Adamya, a Product Manager with 3.5+ years across 0-to-N product development, GTM strategy, and marketing analytics. I've shipped end-to-end lifecycles — from MVP to market expansion — for B2B and D2C e-commerce, including digital journeys and Agentic AI solutions. I lead cross-functional teams toward quantifiable impact: 17% retention lifts, 3000+ new premium sellers, and AI products generating 100+ Cr in monthly revenue. I think customer-first, decide data-first, and love turning ambiguous problems into measurable outcomes.

projects.title: Growmatic
projects.description: An AI-driven CRM that automates lead qualification and ad-content generation to simplify marketing for SMBs. Designed to compress the qualify-to-convert funnel and let small teams run enterprise-grade lead ops without a dedicated marketing function.
projects.objective: SMBs lack the bandwidth and budget for a dedicated marketing team — yet still need to qualify leads and generate ad content daily. Growmatic plugs that gap with an AI-driven CRM that automates both, letting small teams run enterprise-grade lead operations without extra headcount.

keyInsights.label: Core Problem
keyInsights.text: SMBs spend 60%+ of their time manually sorting leads and rewriting ad copy instead of selling.

keyInsights.label: Multi-Agent Orchestration
keyInsights.text: Separate agents handle lead scoring, qualification dialogue, and ad-copy generation — each specialised, all coordinated.

keyInsights.label: RAG-Powered Context
keyInsights.text: A retrieval-augmented pipeline feeds each agent live product and CRM data so outputs are accurate and personalised.

keyInsights.label: Funnel Compression
keyInsights.text: End-to-end automation compresses the qualify-to-convert cycle from days to minutes.

keyInsights.label: Live Prototype
keyInsights.text: Deployed on Vercel — fully functional with login, lead dashboard, and AI-generated ad previews.

projects.title: Bundles & Buddy Mode
projects.description: Quick-commerce features that convert reactive checkouts into planned purchases, designed to drive AOV growth for a Blinkit-style platform. 'Bundles' nudges complementary add-ons at checkout; 'Buddy Mode' enables shared, planned carts — both targeting basket size and repeat ordering.

images.alt: Bundles & Buddy Mode — quick-commerce checkout concept

projects.objective: Quick-commerce platforms like Blinkit have strong repeat visit rates but low average order values — users buy reactively, one or two items at a time. Two features fix this: Bundles nudges smart add-ons at checkout; Buddy Mode turns solo runs into shared, planned carts.

keyInsights.label: Bundles
keyInsights.text: AI-curated complementary product nudges shown at checkout — increasing basket size without feeling pushy.

keyInsights.label: Buddy Mode
keyInsights.text: Shared cart feature that lets friends or flatmates plan grocery runs together, driving commitment to larger orders.

keyInsights.label: Behavioural Design
keyInsights.text: Leverages loss aversion and social commitment loops to convert reactive shoppers into planned purchasers.

keyInsights.label: AOV Impact
keyInsights.text: Both features target average order value and repeat ordering — two of the highest-leverage quick-commerce metrics.

keyInsights.label: Platform Fit
keyInsights.text: Designed specifically for Blinkit's UX patterns and logistics model — not a generic add-on.

projects.title: Xcurson
projects.description: An AI travel planner built via vibe-coding, with a modular architecture for crafting contextual, personalized itineraries. Turns loose trip intent into structured, day-by-day plans tailored to user preferences.
projects.objective: Planning a trip means juggling blogs, spreadsheets, maps, and review sites for hours — only to end up with a generic itinerary. Xcurson converts vague travel intent into a structured, personalised day-by-day plan in a single conversation.

keyInsights.label: The Problem
keyInsights.text: Trip planning is fragmented across 5+ tools and takes an average of 4–6 hours even for a short getaway.

keyInsights.label: Modular AI Architecture
keyInsights.text: Separate agents handle preference capture, destination research, logistics, and day sequencing independently.

keyInsights.label: Structured Output
keyInsights.text: Produces readable, day-by-day itineraries with place-specific context — not generic suggestions.

keyInsights.label: Vibe-Coded
keyInsights.text: Built end-to-end using Lovable + LLM orchestration — from product concept to live prototype in days.

keyInsights.label: Live
keyInsights.text: Deployed and publicly accessible — real users can plan trips right now.

projects.title: SAM: AI Chatbot with RAG
projects.description: A multi-capability AI agent built with LangGraph and Streamlit, combining RAG-powered knowledge retrieval, live web search, and a code interpreter — all within a multi-threaded chat interface with real-time response streaming. Maintains persistent context across parallel conversation threads for a coherent, research-grade assistant experience.

images.alt: SAM — AI chatbot with RAG, web search and code interpreter

projects.objective: Most AI assistants are stateless and single-purpose — they forget context and can't combine knowledge retrieval, live search, and code execution in one conversation. SAM is a multi-capability research agent that does all three, across parallel threads with persistent memory.

keyInsights.label: RAG Knowledge Retrieval
keyInsights.text: Retrieval-augmented generation ensures factual, document-grounded answers — not hallucinations.

keyInsights.label: Live Web Search
keyInsights.text: Real-time search integration keeps responses current beyond the model's training cutoff.

keyInsights.label: Code Interpreter
keyInsights.text: Inline code execution lets SAM run Python, debug logic, and return results — all within the chat.

keyInsights.label: Multi-threaded Memory
keyInsights.text: Parallel conversation threads each maintain their own persistent context for coherent, long-running sessions.

keyInsights.label: Real-time Streaming
keyInsights.text: Token-by-token response streaming makes the interface feel fast and natural — not a loading spinner.

projects.title: Linkedin : Improving Job Hunting Experience
projects.description: A PM case study focused on improving the job-hunting experience for Active Job Seekers on LinkedIn. Identified 'unresponsive DMs' as the top pain point causing seeker churn, then designed a native Referral Request loop — a structured 3-part MVP (request creation, feed-surface delivery, and follow-through automation) that closes the gap between cold outreach and actual referrals. Includes network effect mapping, pain point prioritization, solution scoping, mockups, and a metrics framework.
projects.objective: Active job seekers on LinkedIn hit a wall after applying — cold DMs go unanswered, and the platform offers no structured way to ask for or give referrals. The biggest friction isn't finding jobs; it's closing the gap between outreach and a real conversation.

keyInsights.label: Root Cause
keyInsights.text: Cold DMs feel transactional to referrers — no context, no structure, no incentive to respond.

keyInsights.label: The Solution
keyInsights.text: A native Referral Request loop: a 3-part MVP (request creation → feed delivery → follow-through automation).

keyInsights.label: Request Creation
keyInsights.text: Structured ask form with role context, personalisation fields, and a clear call-to-action — reducing friction for both parties.

keyInsights.label: Feed Surface Delivery
keyInsights.text: Referral requests appear in the giver's feed as cards, making them visible without requiring cold outreach.

keyInsights.label: Follow-through Automation
keyInsights.text: Automated status tracking closes the loop — seekers know where they stand, referrers stay accountable.

projects.title: Pocket
projects.description: An AI expense tracker offering smart cash-flow management and visual summaries that explain spending habits. Translates raw transactions into plain-language insights so users understand the 'why' behind their spending.

images.alt: Pocket — AI expense tracker with spending insights

projects.objective: Most expense trackers show you what you spent — but not why, and not what to change. Pocket uses AI to translate raw transactions into plain-language spending narratives, so users actually understand their cash flow instead of just watching it.

keyInsights.label: The Gap
keyInsights.text: Raw transaction lists don't change behaviour — users need context and narrative, not just numbers.

keyInsights.label: AI-Powered Insights
keyInsights.text: LLM summaries explain spending patterns in plain language: 'You spent 40% more on food delivery this week because of 3 late nights.'

keyInsights.label: Visual Cash Flow
keyInsights.text: Interactive charts surface spending trends, category breakdowns, and month-over-month shifts at a glance.

keyInsights.label: Proactive Alerts
keyInsights.text: Predictive nudges flag overspend risk before it happens — not after the bill arrives.

keyInsights.label: Goal
keyInsights.text: Turn passive expense tracking into an active financial awareness tool that changes how people relate to money.

projects.title: IMDB Sentiment & Topic Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed 40,000+ IMDB reviews using VADER and Logistic Regression, achieving 78.23% accuracy in sentiment and topic analysis. Surfaces what drives positive vs. negative reception at scale.
projects.objective: Understanding what makes a film review positive or negative at scale requires more than reading samples. This project applied NLP pipelines to 40,000+ IMDB reviews to surface the themes and signals that drive audience sentiment — at machine speed.

keyInsights.label: Scale
keyInsights.text: 40,000+ IMDB reviews processed — large enough to surface statistically meaningful patterns across genres and release periods.

keyInsights.label: VADER Sentiment
keyInsights.text: Rule-based lexicon scoring for fast, interpretable sentiment classification without training data overhead.

keyInsights.label: Logistic Regression
keyInsights.text: Supervised classifier achieving 78.23% accuracy — strong baseline for a text-only, feature-engineered model.

keyInsights.label: Topic Modeling
keyInsights.text: Latent themes extracted from reviews — revealing what viewers actually write about: acting, pacing, story, and visuals.

keyInsights.label: Outcome
keyInsights.text: A reproducible NLP framework for reception analysis — applicable to any text review corpus at scale.

projects.title: Niyam (AI Fitness Coach)
projects.description: An AI fitness coach that generates personalized workout and habit plans and keeps users accountable to their goals.
projects.objective: Generic fitness apps give everyone the same plan regardless of their goals, schedule, or progress. Niyam generates personalised workout and habit plans in a conversational interface — then acts as a daily accountability partner that adapts as you improve.

keyInsights.label: Personalisation
keyInsights.text: AI-generated plans built around individual goals, current fitness level, available equipment, and weekly schedule.

keyInsights.label: Conversational UX
keyInsights.text: Chat-first interface for check-ins, plan adjustments, and motivation — not a rigid form-fill flow.

keyInsights.label: Accountability Automation
keyInsights.text: Daily reminders and session logs automated via N8N workflows — so the coach follows up even when you forget.

keyInsights.label: Adaptive Plans
keyInsights.text: Workout plans evolve based on logged sessions and progress — getting harder or easier based on real performance.

keyInsights.label: Built With
keyInsights.text: Vibe-coded using Lovable for the UI + N8N for backend automation workflows — shipped in days, not months.

projects.title: Onset : Investment Platform
projects.description: An investment platform concept that simplifies portfolio building and guides first-time investors through their first steps.
projects.objective: First-time investors get overwhelmed the moment they open a brokerage app — complex dashboards, financial jargon, and no guided starting point. Onset simplifies portfolio building with a step-by-step, AI-assisted onboarding experience designed for beginners.

keyInsights.label: The Drop-off Problem
keyInsights.text: Most first-time investors abandon investment apps in their first week — not from lack of intent, but from decision paralysis.

keyInsights.label: Guided Journey
keyInsights.text: Step-by-step onboarding walks users from 'what's my risk profile' to 'here's your starter portfolio' — no prior knowledge needed.

keyInsights.label: AI-Assisted Prototype
keyInsights.text: Built using Claude Artifacts — demonstrating how AI-assisted prototyping can compress concept-to-demo from weeks to hours.

keyInsights.label: Simplicity-First Design
keyInsights.text: Jargon-free interface with visual risk indicators and plain-language explanations for every financial concept shown.

keyInsights.label: Core Goal
keyInsights.text: Lower the psychological and UX barrier between 'I want to invest' and 'I made my first investment'.

projects.title: Zomato : Farm Fresh
projects.description: A farm-to-table feature concept for Zomato ('Farm Fresh' / BiteBox) connecting users with fresh local produce.

images.alt: Zomato Farm Fresh — farm-to-table feature concept

projects.objective: India's quick-commerce platforms dominate packaged and processed groceries — but no major player owns the 'fresh, traceable, locally-sourced produce' category. Farm Fresh / BiteBox creates that channel for Zomato, targeting health-conscious urban users who distrust packaged goods.

keyInsights.label: Market Gap
keyInsights.text: No major quick-commerce player credibly owns fresh, farm-sourced produce — a high-trust, growing category.

keyInsights.label: Supply-side Model
keyInsights.text: Direct farmer-to-door supply chain bypasses mandis — ensuring freshness while improving farmer margins.

keyInsights.label: Target Segment
keyInsights.text: Health-conscious urban millennials and families who care about provenance, not just price and speed.

keyInsights.label: BiteBox Subscription
keyInsights.text: Curated weekly produce box model drives predictable demand and reduces logistics complexity.

keyInsights.label: GTM Strategy
keyInsights.text: Hyper-local city-by-city launch starting with farmer-dense metro fringe zones — proving unit economics before scaling.

projects.title: OpenAI : Project TAGs
projects.description: A feature concept that adds tagging and organization to ChatGPT Projects for faster workspace navigation.

images.alt: OpenAI Project TAGs — ChatGPT Projects tagging concept

projects.objective: As ChatGPT Projects grow in number, users end up with dozens of unorganised projects and no fast way to find what they need. Project TAGs adds a lightweight tagging layer that lets users organise and navigate their workspace in seconds.

keyInsights.label: The Problem
keyInsights.text: ChatGPT Projects has no search, filter, or organisational layer — users scroll through an ever-growing flat list.

keyInsights.label: The Solution
keyInsights.text: User-defined tags applied to Projects — self-organised, flexible, and zero-friction to create.

keyInsights.label: Instant Navigation
keyInsights.text: Tag-based filtering cuts workspace navigation from scrolling to a single click.

keyInsights.label: UX Principle
keyInsights.text: Minimum viable interaction — tag inline, filter in one click, no modal or settings required.

keyInsights.label: Prototype
keyInsights.text: Interactive concept built with Lovable and visualised via Claude Artifact — shareable and explorable.

projects.title: LLM Fine-tuning : Llama Model on Custom Dataset
projects.description: Fine-tuned a Llama model on a custom dataset — covering data preparation, training, and evaluation.
projects.objective: Pre-trained LLMs excel at general tasks but underperform on domain-specific queries without adaptation. This project demonstrates a complete fine-tuning pipeline — from dataset preparation to training and evaluation — using parameter-efficient methods on Llama 3.

keyInsights.label: Base Model
keyInsights.text: Llama 3 fine-tuned via instruction tuning to follow domain-specific prompts accurately.

keyInsights.label: PEFT / LoRA
keyInsights.text: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with LoRA adapters — dramatically reduces GPU memory and training time vs. full fine-tuning.

keyInsights.label: Dataset Pipeline
keyInsights.text: End-to-end custom dataset preparation: collection, cleaning, formatting into instruction-response pairs, and tokenisation.

keyInsights.label: Evaluation
keyInsights.text: Model benchmarked on accuracy, perplexity, and response quality against the base model baseline.

keyInsights.label: Stack
keyInsights.text: Hugging Face Transformers + PEFT library + Google Colab — fully reproducible via the linked notebook.

projects.title: Growth Strategy of Jio
projects.description: A comprehensive analysis of Reliance Jio's hypergrowth strategy — examining how it disrupted India's telecom market through aggressive pricing, vertical integration, and ecosystem lock-in to become the country's largest telecom operator.
projects.objective: How does a new entrant with no customers disrupt and dominate India's entrenched telecom market in under three years? This analysis deconstructs Jio's sequenced strategy — from infrastructure-first investment to ecosystem lock-in — and why incumbents couldn't respond fast enough.

keyInsights.label: Free Launch Blitzkrieg
keyInsights.text: 6 months of free data and voice calls acquired 100M+ users before any revenue pressure — forcing competitors into price wars they couldn't win.

keyInsights.label: Infrastructure Moat
keyInsights.text: ₹1.5 lakh crore in 4G rollout before launch — Jio was the only operator with nationwide coverage from day one.

keyInsights.label: Ecosystem Lock-in
keyInsights.text: JioTV, JioCinema, JioSaavn, JioMart — a closed app ecosystem that made switching costly beyond just the SIM.

keyInsights.label: Competitive Collapse
keyInsights.text: Forced Airtel, Idea, and Vodafone into survival mergers — reducing a fragmented market of 8+ operators to effectively 3.

keyInsights.label: Macro Outcome
keyInsights.text: India went from one of the world's most expensive data markets to the cheapest — under $0.10/GB average.

projects.title: ML Applications in Diagnosis of Diabetes
projects.description: An exploration of how machine learning models — including logistic regression, decision trees, and neural networks — can be applied to early diabetes diagnosis, comparing model accuracy, interpretability, and clinical applicability.

images.alt: ML Applications in Diagnosis of Diabetes

projects.objective: Over 77 million adults in India have diabetes — and a significant portion are undiagnosed until complications arise. This research explores whether ML models can flag risk earlier and more reliably than traditional clinical thresholds, comparing accuracy, interpretability, and real-world applicability.

keyInsights.label: Clinical Urgency
keyInsights.text: 1 in 11 adults globally has diabetes; most Type 2 diagnoses come 5–7 years after onset — early detection saves lives.

keyInsights.label: Models Compared
keyInsights.text: Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, and Neural Networks evaluated on the same feature set and dataset.

keyInsights.label: Key Predictors
keyInsights.text: Glucose level, BMI, age, insulin, and blood pressure emerged as the strongest diagnostic signals.

keyInsights.label: Accuracy vs. Explainability
keyInsights.text: Neural nets had the highest raw accuracy; decision trees offered comparable performance with clinically interpretable rules.

keyInsights.label: Clinical Recommendation
keyInsights.text: Decision Tree emerged as the best balance of accuracy and explainability — a doctor can follow its logic at bedside.

projects.title: Marketing Strategy of Nike
projects.description: A deep-dive into Nike's global marketing playbook — covering brand positioning, athlete endorsements, digital-first campaigns, community building through Nike Run Club & Training Club, and how storytelling drives premium pricing power.
projects.objective: Nike sells sneakers at 3–5x the price of comparable products. This analysis unpacks how — reverse-engineering the brand strategy, athlete partnerships, digital community tools, and storytelling playbook that sustain premium pricing power and global brand loyalty.

keyInsights.label: Brand Positioning
keyInsights.text: 'Just Do It' is a motivational identity, not a product slogan — it sells aspiration, not shoes.

keyInsights.label: Athlete Endorsements
keyInsights.text: Cultural identity transfer: associating with elite athletes makes consumers feel the brand elevates them too.

keyInsights.label: Community-Led Loyalty
keyInsights.text: Nike Run Club and Training Club build daily habits — turning customers into participants in a movement.

keyInsights.label: Emotion-First Campaigns
keyInsights.text: Advertising leads with human stories and triumph — products appear last, if at all.

keyInsights.label: Premium Pricing Power
keyInsights.text: Brand identity perceived as self-expression sustains margins even as production costs remain commodity-level.

projects.title: GTM Strategy for New Product by Cisco
projects.description: A go-to-market plan for a new Cisco product targeting enterprise network security — covering ICP definition, channel strategy, competitive positioning, pricing model, and launch sequencing across geographies.

images.alt: GTM Strategy for New Product by Cisco

projects.objective: Launching a new enterprise network security product into a saturated B2B market requires more than a feature list — it needs a sequenced market entry, a razor-sharp ICP, differentiated positioning against legacy players, and a channel strategy that scales.

keyInsights.label: ICP Definition
keyInsights.text: Mid-to-large enterprises with multi-cloud exposure and legacy perimeter security — highest pain, highest willingness to pay.

keyInsights.label: Channel Strategy
keyInsights.text: Direct enterprise sales for large accounts; MSSP partner ecosystem for mid-market reach without headcount.

keyInsights.label: Competitive Positioning
keyInsights.text: AI-first threat detection vs. rule-based legacy solutions — faster response, fewer false positives, less analyst fatigue.

keyInsights.label: Pricing Model
keyInsights.text: Usage-based SaaS subscription aligns with enterprise budget cycles and removes CapEx friction from the buying decision.

keyInsights.label: Launch Sequencing
keyInsights.text: Pilot with 3 lighthouse accounts → case study-led scale → geographic expansion across 3 priority regions.

projects.title: Business Strategy of ABC
projects.description: A strategic analysis of ABC's business model — examining competitive positioning, value chain, growth levers, and strategic recommendations to sustain long-term advantage in a dynamic market landscape.
projects.objective: Sustaining competitive advantage in a price-sensitive, crowded market requires more than cost efficiency — it demands identifying where you create unique value and doubling down on it. This analysis maps ABC's value chain, surfaces strategic gaps, and proposes concrete levers for differentiation.

keyInsights.label: Value Chain Mapping
keyInsights.text: Primary and support activities mapped against key competitors — identifying where ABC leads and where it leaks value.

keyInsights.label: Core Strengths
keyInsights.text: Deep distribution network and high customer relationship density — advantages that take years for competitors to replicate.

keyInsights.label: Strategic Gaps
keyInsights.text: Underdeveloped digital channels and weak brand premium leave ABC vulnerable to D2C disruptors and price wars.

keyInsights.label: Recommendations
keyInsights.text: D2C channel pivot, loyalty programme launch, and AI-enabled operations to reduce cost-to-serve.

keyInsights.label: Growth Levers
keyInsights.text: Premiumisation of core SKUs + geographic expansion into Tier 2/3 markets as the dual growth engine.

projects.title: V-Guard Big Idea : Product Innovation

Developed and pitched a full product innovation concept, combining customer insight, market sizing, and go-to-market strategy to address a real consumer problem in the home appliances space.
projects.objective: V-Guard challenged participants to develop a new product concept for India's home appliances market — from consumer insight to business case. Competing among 2000+ ideas from across the country, this concept combined a real unmet need, full market sizing, and an AI-enabled product vision.

keyInsights.label: Result
keyInsights.text: National Finalist among 2000+ product ideas from colleges and institutions across India.

keyInsights.label: Consumer Insight
keyInsights.text: Identified an unmet need in the home appliances category through primary research and pain-point mapping.

keyInsights.label: Market Sizing
keyInsights.text: TAM/SAM/SOM analysis quantified the opportunity — giving the business case credibility beyond the concept.

keyInsights.label: AI-Enabled Features

keyInsights.label: Full GTM Plan
keyInsights.text: Channel strategy, pricing tiers, launch roadmap, and partnership model — a complete go-to-market blueprint.

projects.objective: Tata Steel challenged participants to solve real business problems across operations, CX, and strategy in one of India's most complex industries. This solution combined operational analysis, data-driven recommendations, and a structured CX improvement framework — presented to a panel of Tata Steel leaders.

keyInsights.label: Industry Context
keyInsights.text: Steel is capital-intensive and operationally complex — small efficiency gains translate to crores in savings at scale.

keyInsights.label: Operational Analysis
keyInsights.text: Mapped inefficiency hotspots across the value chain using data — identifying where losses were systemic vs. incidental.

keyInsights.label: AI Application
keyInsights.text: Proposed ML-based demand forecasting to reduce inventory carrying costs and production over-runs.

keyInsights.label: CX Strategy

keyInsights.text: Solution presented to a panel of Tata Steel industry leaders — combining analytical rigour with executive-ready storytelling.
